topic: win the first hour of the morning
lines: #The first hour of your day is a *vote.*
For the person you're trying to *become.*
Or the person you're trying to *escape.*
#Most people start their day by picking up their *phone.*
Someone else's problems. Someone else's *life.*
Before they've even said one word to *themselves.*
#Winners protect that first hour like it's *money.*
Because it *is.*
Get up. Make the bed. Drink some *water.*
Move your body until your mind *wakes up.*
Write down the *one* thing that matters today.
And do it before the world gets a *vote.*
#It's not about waking up at five in the *morning.*
It's about waking up *on purpose.*
Every morning you win, your confidence gets a little *louder.*
Every morning you lose, your excuses get more *comfortable.*
#Tomorrow morning, you get another *vote.*
Make it *count.*
Starting *now.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.
